full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad featuring a male tenor vocalist. The arrangement begins with a solo grand piano playing arpeggiated chords and a melodic top line. A clean electric guitar enters with palm-muted rhythmic accents. The bass guitar plays sustained root notes. Orchestral strings provide legato pads in the background. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal delivery is breathy in the lower register, transitioning to a powerful, resonant chest voice during the build-up. Reverb is applied to the vocals and piano to create a sense of space.
